title: Cost Context Composer: per-call provenance & export flow
creator: Ava Mitchell
description: Design a lightweight, exportable 'Cost Context Composer' UX surface inside Redwood Console that lets engineering and product teams inspect per-invocation provenance (prompt + model variant + routing decision + KV-cache hits), attribute microcosts to facets (route, model, prompt template, user segment), and export a tidy CSV/JSON for downstream chargeback and analytics. This ticket covers the prototype, usability review, and handoff assets for engineering to implement the first MVP column set and an export job (CSV + compact JSON schema).
design_decisions: Surface a compact provenance row for each invocation: timestamp, route, model_version, worker_tier, seq_len_in/out, token_count, cache_status, routing_reason
Default view groups by 'session' with an expand-to-row detail to avoid overwhelming dashboards with millions of rows
Export schema will include denormalized attribution fields (route, model, prompt_template_id, customer_tag) to make downstream joins lightweight
We will show estimated USD cost per-invocation computed client-side from server-provided unit rates (keeps Console responsive during browsing)
Primary export formats: CSV for finance teams, compact JSON for programmatic ingestion (schema v1)
acceptance_criteria: Prototype (Figma) includes list view, row expand, attribution pill group, and export modal
Design review notes addressed and sign-off from PM and Eng reviewer recorded
Export schema doc (Confluence) published and linked in ticket
Edge cases: redacted PII in prompt text confirmed with Security/Legal
Handoff package with tokens for implementation (color, spacing, accessible labels) uploaded to the implementation PR
